dedupe_keys.name: galileo quarterly service performance reports european gnss service centre

description: The European GNSS Service Centre, run for the EU Agency for the Space Programme, publishes quarterly performance reports of the Galileo services, giving measured performance statistics against the minimum performance levels committed in each service definition document. Separate series cover the Galileo Open Service, Open Service Navigation Message Authentication (OSNMA), the High Accuracy Service (HAS) and the Search and Rescue service, with values such as availability, ranging and positioning accuracy, timing accuracy and service outages; the centre's site also gives constellation status, notices to Galileo users (NAGUs) on outages and events, and orbital parameters. Coverage: the Galileo global service, quarterly since the start of initial services in 2016 and later services as they began. Format and access: PDF reports in the GSC electronic library, free under the EU's reuse policy. Caveats: statistics are aggregated per quarter and per service; user-level performance depends on receivers and environment; EGNOS performance is reported elsewhere. Simulation uses: service performance baselines for systems that depend on satellite positioning and timing, and outage records for resilience studies. Related records: the FAA WAAS reports and IGS products give US augmentation and precise products.
